repeats.name: Sofia
repeats.line: "Yeah? What's up?"

repeats.name: Lena
repeats.line: "Here's a story: Ivy once stayed up all night on watch so someone else could sleep. That's who Ivy is, when it counts."

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

repeats.name: Lena
repeats.line: "My advice? Give Hazel time. We're all still becoming whoever we are now."

repeats.name: Hazel
repeats.line: "Lena was a welder, before. You can still see it — the way they handle things."

repeats.name: Dale
repeats.line: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: "If you're going to deal with Tariq — be direct. Nothing sideways. Tariq smells sideways a mile off."

repeats.name: Amina
repeats.line: "Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: You don't answer. The quiet turns pointed.

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: "Lena is back. Walked in like they'd never left."

repeats.name: Lena
repeats.line: You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: "Still on what was on their mind."

repeats.name: Amina
repeats.line: "I used to think worse of Diana. The scattering has a way of... editing people. Mostly for the better. Mostly."

repeats.name: Sofia
repeats.line: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

repeats.name: Lena
repeats.line: You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: Ivy has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)

repeats.name: Lena
repeats.line: "Still on the others. That's still where we are."

repeats.name: Sofia
repeats.line: "Hm. Never mind — go on."

repeats.name: Ivy
repeats.line: "As I said — Still on the others."

repeats.name: Sofia
repeats.line: They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
